dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,22)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey! You! Who d’ya think you are, waltzin’ onto my turf?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,22)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Ei! Você! Quem você pensa que é, valsin' em meu território?!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,7)>Watch it, pal—this is MY turf! Now get lost!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,7)>Cuidado, amigo - este é o meu território! Agora, desapareça!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,7)><$voicel(1,7)>You’ve got some nerve sayin’ that to my face, bud! Guess
we’re gonna have to battle to decide whose turf it is!<$facial(0,9)><$comeff(0,4)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,7)><$voicel(1,7)>Você tem um pouco de coragem dizendo isso na minha cara, amigo!
vamos ter que batalhar para decidir de quem é o território!<$facial(0,9)><$comeff(0,4)>

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,7)>Fine by me! These claws can crush boulders, so pounding
you into a pulp’ll be a cinch!
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,816)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Snip snap!<$motion(2,815)><$facial(2,1)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,7)>Estas garras podem esmagar pedras, por isso, a bater
você em uma polpa 'll ser uma cinta!
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,816)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Snip snap!<$motion(2,815)><$facial(2,1)>

dialogues.en:
<$facial(0,1)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>Hah! You obviously haven’t heard how strong my fangs
are, huh?!
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,8)>You’re all excited about bustin’ up li’l rocks, but I can rip
through sheet iron! <$voicel(1,9)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)>Sharrrrrr!<$motion(1,815)><$facial(1,1)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(0,1)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>Hah! Você obviamente ainda não ouviu o quão forte minhas presas
são, huh?!
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,8)>Você está todo animado sobre bustin’ até pedras li’l, mas eu posso rasgar
Através de ferro de folha! <$voicel(1,9)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)>Sharrrrr!<$motion(1,815)><$facial(1,1)>

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)>Hold up—sheet iron? <$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,4)>Dang, this punk actually seems
like a pretty tough customer... <$comcan(2)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,2)>Snip...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)>Segura-te, ferro de folha? <$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,4)>Caramba, este punk parece mesmo
Como um cliente muito duro... <$comcan(2)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,2)>Cortar...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,1)>Huh... Those claws DO look like they’d be pretty painful.
And they seem pretty confident with ’em, too. Maybe this
li’l rascal’s kinda tough after all... <$comcan(1)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)>Sharrr...
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>Ugh. Y’know what? Let’s not. Let’s just not. Fightin’ over
silly stuff is pretty silly anyway, right?
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>As long as you play it cool around here, I guess we can be
friends or whatever!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,1)>Aquelas garras parecem ser muito dolorosas.
E eles parecem muito confiantes com eles, também.
li’l patife é meio difícil afinal de contas... <$comcan(1)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)>Sharrr...
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>Ugh. Você sabe o quê? Não vamos. Não vamos. Não vamos. Lutar’ mais
As coisas tolas são muito tolas, certo?
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>Desde que fiques calmo por aqui, acho que podemos ser...
Amigos ou o que seja!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>O-oh, yeah, sure! I was thinkin’ the same thing, pal!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>O-oh, sim, claro! Eu estava pensando’ a mesma coisa, amigo!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,4)>Hmmm... I just can’t help but wonder...
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,4)>Hmmm... Eu simplesmente não posso deixar de pensar...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,5)>Huh? What’re you, uh, staring at me for?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,5)>Porque está a olhar para mim?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Hey, <$cdef(27)><$cname(586)>. Do you have, like...legs under the ground?
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,8)>I wanna see!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Olá. <$cdef(27)><$cname(586)>tem, tipo... pernas debaixo do chão?
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,8)>Quero ver!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,10)>Huh? THAT’S what you’re interested in? <wait(2.0)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,4)>Hmmm...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,10)>Huh? É nisso que você está interessado? <wait(2.0)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,4)>Hmmm...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,6)>I just wanna know more about you... <wait(1.2)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,662)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>C’mon, show me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,6)>Só quero saber mais sobre ti... <wait(1.2)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,662)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Vamos, mostre-me!

<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)><$pkcry;0(2,1)>! You do? That makes me happy! <$emotion(2,65)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,2)>Well, if

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>I only

show Barboach.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)>Whoa, awesome! So THAT’S how you look under there...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,9)>Uau, incrível! Então é assim que você olha lá embaixo...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,1)>Hehe... It’s kinda embarrassing...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,1)>Hehe... é um pouco embaraçoso...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Sooo...under the ground, <$cdef(27)><$cname(586)> </color>is—
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Sob o chão, <$cdef(27)><$cname(586)> </color>É...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Ahhh! Stop, stop! Could you keep it a secret between you
and me, <$cdef(27)><$cname(560)>?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Podem guardar segredo entre vocês?
e eu, <$cdef(27)><$cname(560)>?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,3)>*sigh* I’ve been feeling so slowww lately...
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,3)>*suspiro * Eu tenho me sentido tão lentoww ultimamente ...

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,32)><$voicel(2,5)>You wanna get amped up? I know a good way to do that!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,32)><$voicel(2,5)>Eu sei uma boa maneira de fazer isso!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,53)><$voicel(1,7)>Reeeaaally? Tell me more...
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,53)><$voicel(1,7)>Conta-me mais...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,817)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Just do this!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,817)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Faz isto!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,59)><$voicel(1,3)>Awww... I can’t do that...
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,59)><$voicel(1,3)>Awww... Eu não posso fazer isso...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,5)>Huh, OK... Then how about just moving around a bit?
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,9)>Like this! See?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,5)>Está bem, então que tal mudares-te um pouco?
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,9)>Assim!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,6)>Oh, yeah... I think I can do thaaat. <wait(1.2)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,814)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,8)>Hyaaa.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,6)>Sim, acho que consigo fazer isso. <wait(1.2)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,814)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,8)>Hyaaa.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Whoa, nice! Now pick up the pep!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Agora, apanha a animação!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,814)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Phew... <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,817)><$facial(1,7)><$voicel(1,10)>Hya... Hyaaaaaa!
<$emotion(1,59)><$voicel(1,2)><$kfacial(1)>*pant* *wheeze* Urrrrgh...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,814)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Ufa... <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,817)><$facial(1,7)><$voicel(1,10)>Hyaaaaaaaa!
<$emotion(1,59)><$voicel(1,2)><$kfacial(1)>* Pantera* * Wheeze* Urrrrgh...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>All warmed up? OK, next up: let’s race! <wait(0.3)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,7)>Full speed ahead!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>Tudo aquecido? OK, próximo: vamos correr! <wait(0.3)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,7)>Velocidade máxima à frente!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,815)><$facial(1,13)><$voicel(1,7)>What? Nooo... That was enough...
<$voicel(1,2)>Um... <$lookat(1,0,1)><$lookat(1,1,1)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,6)>Oh yeah... I have some important things to do
today... <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,9)>I should really get going. See you laaater...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,815)><$facial(1,13)><$voicel(1,7)>- Não, já chega.
<$voicel(1,2)>Um... <$lookat(1,0,1)><$lookat(1,1,1)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,6)>Tenho coisas importantes para fazer.
Hoje... <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,9)>Tenho de ir andando.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,2)>What? But we just got started...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,2)>Mas começámos agora...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Y’know, <$cdef(27)><$cname(595)>... Lookin’ at your jaw makes me feel like
we might be distant relatives or somethin’!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Você sabe, <$cdef(27)><$cname(595)>... Olhando para o seu maxilar me faz sentir como
podemos ser parentes distantes ou algo assim!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>I kinda get the same feelin’ ’bout you when I take a
gander at them claws o’ yers!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Eu meio que tenho o mesmo sentimento 'sobre você quando eu tomar um
Olhe para as garras deles!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,6)>My...claws?
<$emotion(1,27)><$voicel(1,7)>Yooo! I think I figured it out! It’s ’cause we both got these
cool jagged edges!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,6)>As minhas... garras?
<$emotion(1,27)><$voicel(1,7)>Yooo! Eu acho que eu descobri isso! É ’porque nós dois temos estes
Arestas frias e irregulares!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)>Hey! Ya might be onto somethin’ there!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)>Hey! Você pode estar em alguma coisa’ lá!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>That gives me a great idea! <$cdef(27)><$cname(595)>, let’s make a group
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,662)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,6)>dedicated to tellin’ people how cool jagged edges are!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Isso dá-me uma grande ideia! <$cdef(27)><$cname(595)>, vamos fazer um grupo
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,662)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,6)>dedicado a dizer às pessoas como as bordas irregulares são legais!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Ohhh! Good idea! I reckon we could call ourselves the
Jagged Coalition!
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,5)>Let’s get to work right away! We can start by makin’ all the
buildings round here nice ’n’ jagged.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Boa ideia, acho que podemos chamar-nos
Coalizão Jagged!
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,5)>Vamos começar a trabalhar imediatamente! Podemos começar por fazer todos os
edifícios por aqui agradável 'n' irregular.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>YEAH! And we can make the ground all jagged, too!
<$emotion(1,197)><$voicel(1,5)>But, uh... I guess it wouldn’t be very nice to mess with the
town <$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,4)><$cdef(27)> made for us, huh...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>E também podemos fazer o chão ficar embaçado!
<$emotion(1,197)><$voicel(1,5)>Mas, uh... Eu acho que não seria muito bom para mexer com o
cidade <$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,4)><$cdef(27)> Feito para nós, huh...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,27)><$voicel(2,6)>Huh... S’pose you’re right...
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)> should be the one to decide
how
jagged
things
are
round here!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,27)><$voicel(2,6)>Huh... Suponha que você está certo...
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)> deve ser o único a decidir
como
irregular
coisas
are
Por aqui!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,6)>Yeah! OK, <$cdef(27)>...
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,644)><$facial(1,1)>If ya ever need a reference for how to make the town a li’l
more jagged, <$voicel(1,7)>just think of my claws, yo!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,6)>Está bem. <$cdef(27)>...
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,644)><$facial(1,1)>Se você precisar de uma referência para como fazer da cidade um li’l
mais irregular, <$voicel(1,7)>Pensa nas minhas garras, meu!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,7)>Naw, you’d be better off referencin’ these jaws o’ mine.
That’ll make things look a li’l more fancy!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,7)>Não, você seria melhor fora de referência’ estas mandíbulas o’ mina.
Isso vai fazer as coisas parecerem um li'l mais extravagante!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,6)>I dunno, yo... We’re both members of the Jagged
Coalition, so maybe either’s fine?
<$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,1)>...I think the shape of my claws is a li’l cooler, though.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,6)>Eu não sei, yo... Nós dois somos membros do Jagged
Coalizão, então, talvez algum dos dois esteja bem?
<$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,1)>...Eu acho que a forma das minhas garras é um li’l mais frio, no entanto.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,4)>Mebbe you’re right... <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,10)>Though I reckon the shape o’ my
jaws would make a stronger impression!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,4)>Mebbe você está certo... <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,10)>Embora eu ache que a forma do meu
Os maxilares causariam uma impressão mais forte!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,39)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey, <$cdef(27)><$cname(576)>! The ocean is so huge, isn’t it? <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,6)>Do you
know what’s beyond the ocean?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,39)><$voicel(1,7)>Olá. <$cdef(27)><$cname(576)>O oceano é tão grande, não é? <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,6)>Tu sabe?
sabe o que está além do oceano?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>Well, the thing is, the ocean goes on FOREVER! <$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,5)>And the
more you swim, the more sides of it you’ll see!
Like, some parts of the ocean are super cold with floating
ice, <$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,8)><$kfacial(2)>and others are super warm and crystal clear!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>Bem, o problema é que o oceano continua para sempre! <$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,5)>E o
mais você nada, mais lados dele você vai ver!
Algumas partes do oceano são super frias com flutuação.
gelo, <$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,8)><$kfacial(2)>e outros são super quentes e cristalinas!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)>Whoa, that’s so cool!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)>Uau, isso é tão legal!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,3)>But there is ONE weird thing about it all...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,3)>Mas há uma coisa estranha sobre tudo isso...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>Ooh, what’s that?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>O que é isso?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$voicel(2,3)>You see, whenever I KEEP swimming for a looong time,
I eventually end up right back where I started!
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>I wonder why that is.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$voicel(2,3)>sabe, sempre que eu continuo a nadar durante um tempo de banho,
Acabei por voltar para onde comecei!
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>Pergunto-me porquê.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,3)>Huh, that’s strange... Maybe the ocean is telling you <$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,6)>this is
where you’re meant to return to?
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>I’d love to go swimming with you someday and solve that
mystery, <$cdef(27)><$cname(576)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,3)>Huh, isso é estranho ... Talvez o oceano está dizendo a você <$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,6)>Isto é...
para onde você está destinado a voltar?
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu adoraria ir nadar com você algum dia e resolver isso
mistério, <$cdef(27)><$cname(576)>!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,6)>You really scared me the other day, ya know that, <$cdef(27)>Frillish?
If ya go too deep like that, you could drown!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,6)>Assustaste-me no outro dia. <$cdef(27)>Frillish?
Se fores muito fundo assim, pode afogar-te!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Ugh! I already told you, I’m NOT gonna drown!
<$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>I was just gently floating down to the ocean floor. Gently!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Já te disse, não vou afogar-me!
<$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Estava a flutuar suavemente até ao fundo do oceano.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,27)><$voicel(1,9)>Seriously?! Swimmin’ down super deep like that is no big
deal for you?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,27)><$voicel(1,9)>Sério?! Nadando’ para baixo super profundo como que não é grande
Um acordo para ti?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>Mm-hmm! It’s totally OK!
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>The deep sea’s so wide open. Down there, I can just relax
and swim however I want.
<$comeff(2,20)><$motion(2,644)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, hey! We should all go there together sometime!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>Está tudo bem!
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>O mar profundo é tão largo aberto. Lá em baixo, eu posso apenas relaxar
e nadar como eu quiser.
<$comeff(2,20)><$motion(2,644)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,7)>Devíamos ir todos juntos um dia destes!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,59)><$voicel(1,5)>Oof. I dunno... The deep sea’s all cold and dark and stuff.
Might be kinda rough for <$cdef(27)>.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,59)><$voicel(1,5)>Oof. Eu não sei... O mar profundo é todo frio e escuro e tal.
Pode ser um pouco difícil para <$cdef(27)>.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>Really? I’m sure it’d be a breeze for them!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>Realmente? Tenho certeza que seria uma brisa para eles!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,3)>I know YOU don’t think it’d be a problem, but...
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,7)>I guess I can always rescue everybody if it comes to that.
Maybe it’ll be fine!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,3)>Eu sei que você não acha que seria um problema, mas...
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,7)>Acho que posso sempre salvar toda a gente, se for preciso.
Talvez fique tudo bem!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Ahaha! Swimming in the deep sea all together sounds
SO fun! ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Ahaha! Nadando no mar profundo todos juntos sons
Tão divertido!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>I wanna be a cool grown-up like you, <$cdef(27)><$cname(600)></color>!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>Quero ser um adulto fixe como tu. <$cdef(27)><$cname(600)></color>!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,4)>Why thank you, little one. What a sweet thing to say.
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,6)>But growing up can be rather...
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,2)>*sigh*
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,4)>Obrigado, pequenina, que coisa simpática de se dizer.
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,6)>Mas crescer pode ser um pouco...
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,2)>*suspiro *

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,27)><$voicel(1,10)>Huh? What is it?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,27)><$voicel(1,10)>O que foi?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,3)>It isn’t all sunshine and roses.
<$comeff(2,18)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,1)>My scales no longer shine like they used to, and my
strength is nothing like it once was...
<$voicel(2,6)>Just thinking of it makes me gnash my teeth! <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,9)>*chomp*
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,3)>Nem tudo é sol e rosas.
<$comeff(2,18)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,1)>As minhas escamas já não brilham como costumavam brilhar, e a minha
a força não é nada como era uma vez...
<$voicel(2,6)>Só de pensar nisso, fico a ranger os dentes! <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,9)>* Chomp *

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,6)>Huh? Are you sure you’re not just imagining that?
<$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>I mean, I saw you chomp a huge boulder to bits with your
big teeth!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,6)>Tem certeza de que não está apenas imaginando isso?
<$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Quero dizer, vi-te a mastigar uma pedra enorme com o teu
Dentes grandes!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>Yes, well, it looked so full of nutrients...<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)> But I digress!
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>You are absolutely splendid just as you are now, <$cdef(27)><$cname(598)>.
I don’t think <$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)>you need to be in any hurry to grow up.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>Sim, bem, parecia tão cheio de nutrientes...<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)> Mas eu digresso!
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>Você é absolutamente esplêndido assim como você é agora, <$cdef(27)><$cname(598)>.
Eu não acho <$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)>tem de ter pressa para crescer.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,83)><$voicel(1,4)>Hmmm...
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,9)>No, I really do wanna hurry and grow up! I wanna be a
cool and strong adult!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,83)><$voicel(1,4)>Hmmm...
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,9)>Não, eu quero mesmo que te apresses e cresças!
adulto fresco e forte!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,3)>I see... Well, if you’re absolutely certain, <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)>you ought to
focus on developing your mind.
<$emotion(2,39)><$voicel(2,5)>After all, maturity grows from the inside out, not the other
way around.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,3)>Eu vejo... bem, se você tem certeza absoluta, <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)>Devias...
Concentre-se em desenvolver sua mente.
<$emotion(2,39)><$voicel(2,5)>Afinal, a maturidade cresce de dentro para fora, não a outra.
Bem à volta.

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)><$voicel(1,5)>Inside? So you mean <$voicel(1,5)>I just need to talk like you, <$cdef(27)><$cname(600)>?
<$comcan(1)>... ... ...
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)>Why, hello! My name is <$cdef(27)><$cname(598)>. <$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,9)>*chomp*
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)>Like that?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)><$voicel(1,5)>Então, quer dizer... <$voicel(1,5)>Só preciso de falar como tu. <$cdef(27)><$cname(600)>?
<$comcan(1)>... ... ...
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)>Olá, o meu nome é <$cdef(27)><$cname(598)>. <$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,9)>* Chomp *
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)>Assim?

dialogues.en: <$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,2)>That isn’t quite what I meant...
dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,2)>Isso não é bem o que eu quis dizer...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>My goodness, how elegant you look when you swim!
And the light emitted by your fins is simply mesmerizing.
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,6)>Might I convince you to honor me with a dance?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Meu Deus, como ficas elegante quando nadas!
E a luz emitida pelas suas barbatanas é simplesmente hipnotizante.
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,6)>Posso convencê-lo a honrar-me com uma dança?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,47)><$voicel(1,1)>I don’t knowww. That seems like a lot of effort...
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,47)><$voicel(1,1)>Eu não seiww. Isso parece muito esforço...

dialogues.en: <$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, come now, don’t be like that. Please?
dialogues.pt_br: <$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, vamos lá, não seja assim. Por favor?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,3)>Well... OK. If you help me with some things, then mayyybe
I can dance with you...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,3)>Se me ajudares com umas coisas, Mayyybe...
Posso dançar com você...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh? What sorts of things do you need help with?
Whatever they are, I’d be happy to oblige.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Em que tipo de coisas precisas de ajuda?
O que quer que sejam, eu ficaria feliz em ajudar.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Yayyy. First, I need a berry...
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Primeiro, preciso de uma fruta...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,3)><$voicel(2,6)>All right. Here you are.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,3)><$voicel(2,6)>Muito bem, aqui está.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>Next, I want to hear some really nice music...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>A seguir, quero ouvir uma música muito boa...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,1)>I see... Well, if you insist, I can serenade you a bit.
<$comeff(2,13)><$motion(2,817)><$facial(2,1)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(2,9)>Laaa! ♪ La la laaa la la laaa! ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,1)>Bem, se insistes, posso fazer-te uma serenata.
<$comeff(2,13)><$motion(2,817)><$facial(2,1)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(2,9)>La laaa la laaa!

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,6)>Laaastly, I need someone to clean my home.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,6)>Laaastly, preciso de alguém para limpar a minha casa.

dialogues.en:
... ... ...
<$emotion(2,59)><$voicel(2,3)>This is the last thing you need, yes?
<$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>If so, then all right. I will help you clean!
dialogues.pt_br:
... ... ...
<$emotion(2,59)><$voicel(2,3)>É a última coisa que precisas, não é?
<$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Se sim, então tudo bem. Eu ajudo-te a limpar!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,6)><$voicel(1,9)>Really? Thank you... I’ll for suuure dance with you after
you finish.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,6)><$voicel(1,9)>Realmente? Obrigado... Eu vou para a dança suuure com você depois
Acaba.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,39)><$voicel(2,7)>Dancing with you has been nothing short of incredible!
We should do this again.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,39)><$voicel(2,7)>Dançar com você tem sido nada menos que incrível!
Devíamos fazer isto outra vez.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,216)><$voicel(1,7)>Oooh... Will you help me out again next time?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,216)><$voicel(1,7)>Ajudas-me outra vez da próxima vez?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,59)><$voicel(2,2)>Erm, well... <wait(2.0)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,4)>No, I think not.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,59)><$voicel(2,2)>Bem... <wait(2.0)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,4)>Não, acho que não.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,344)><$voicel(2,3)>Dear...did you make that mess earlier? There were berries
scattered everywhere!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,344)><$voicel(2,3)>Querida... fizeste aquela confusão mais cedo?
Espalhados por todo o lado!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,9)>Hm?! U-uh... I dunno nothin’ ’bout that. Must’ve been
somebody else!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,9)>Hm?! U-uh... Eu não sei nada sobre isso. Deve ter sido
Outra pessoa!

dialogues.en:
<$motion(2,644)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,2)>... ... ...
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,9)><$kfacial(2)>Lying really doesn’t suit you, you know.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(2,644)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,2)>... ... ...
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,9)><$kfacial(2)>Mentir realmente não combina com você, você sabe.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,9)>Ack! Well, shucks... Nothin’ gets past ya, does it?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,9)>Ack! Bem, shucks... Nada passa por você, não é?

dialogues.en:
<$kfacial(1)><$emotion(2,12)><$voicel(2,3)>Your face gives everything away plain as day! You really
should keep things more tidy.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$kfacial(1)><$emotion(2,12)><$voicel(2,3)>A tua cara dá tudo de forma clara!
deve manter as coisas mais arrumadas.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,58)><$voicel(1,2)>S-sorry... I’ll do better...
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,58)><$voicel(1,2)>Desculpe... Vou fazer melhor...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,8)><$kfacial(2)>Come to think of it, you’ve been letting a lot of things
go lately, haven’t you?
<$textsize(0)><$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,4)>Why, just the other day...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,8)><$kfacial(2)>Pensando bem, você tem deixado muitas coisas
ir ultimamente, não é?
<$textsize(0)><$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,4)>Porquê, no outro dia...

dialogues.en:
<$textsize(0)><$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,2)>Aw, here it goes... This’s gonna be a long one, I reckon.

Cresceste agora...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,32)><$voicel(1,5)>You can say that again! Jus’ thinkin’ ’bout it is makin’ me
all nostalgic.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,32)><$voicel(1,5)>Você pode dizer isso de novo! Jus’ pensando 'sobre ele está me fazendo
Tudo nostálgico.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,5)>I was just thiiinking. What if we could grow up even more?
How would you want to chaaange?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,5)>E se pudéssemos crescer ainda mais?
Como é que quer chaaange?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,3)>Hm... Not sure more growin’ is in the cards fer me.
I’m pretty long in the tooth as it is...
<$emotion(1,434)><$voicel(1,7)>But if we’re jus’ talkin’ what-ifs, I guess I’d like this great
jaw o’ mine to get even bigger ’n’ more imposin’!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,3)>Hm... Não sei se mais crescer’ está nas cartas me fer.
Eu sou bastante longo no dente como ele é...
<$emotion(1,434)><$voicel(1,7)>Mas se nós estamos apenas falando’ o que-ses, eu acho que eu gostaria que este grande
mandíbula o’ mina para obter ainda maior 'n' mais imposto!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,39)><$voicel(2,7)>Whoa, yeah... That would be suuuper cool.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,39)><$voicel(2,7)>Isso seria mais fixe.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,230)><$voicel(1,6)>How ’bout you?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,230)><$voicel(1,6)>Que dizer de você?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,9)>Me? Hmmm... I would like to get even strooonger, with
big, powerful arms to match...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,9)>Gostaria de me vingar, com o meu pai.
Braços grandes e poderosos para combinar...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Sounds like a mighty fine way to grow! Plus, you’d be able
to help <$cdef(27)> do even more stuff!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Soa como uma maneira muito boa de crescer! Além disso, você seria capaz
para ajudar <$cdef(27)> Fazer mais coisas!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,39)><$voicel(2,7)>Hehehe... Sooo many possibilities. I hope we really can
keep growing.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,39)><$voicel(2,7)>Tantas possibilidades.
Continua a crescer.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)>Gwahaha! That excitement o’ yers is contagious, I tell
ya what!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)>Gwahaha! Essa emoção é contagioso, eu digo
O quê?

dialogues.en: <$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)>I’m bored... <wait(3.0)><$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,6)>Hey, <$cdef(27)><$cname(580)></color>, tell me a scary story!
dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)>Estou entediado... <wait(3.0)><$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,6)>Olá. <$cdef(27)><$cname(580)></color>Conta-me uma história de terror!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,3)>A scary story, huh? Let me think... OK, I’ll tell ya about the
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>monster I saw living way down in the deep sea.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,3)>Uma história de terror? OK, eu vou te falar sobre o
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>Um monstro que vi no fundo do mar.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,159)><$voicel(1,7)>Oooh, a deep-sea monster?! What was it like?
Tell me, tell me!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,159)><$voicel(1,7)>Como foi?
Diz-me, diz-me!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)>I’ll do ya one better—I’ll show ya!<$facial(2,2)><$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(0,0,2)>
<$emotion(2,230)><$voicel(2,3)>Hey, think you could help me out with some storytellin’,
<$cdef(27)>?
I’m gonna start by describing the monster, and I want you
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>to transform to demonstrate what it looks like!
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,2)><$textsize(0)>Oh, and don’t worry—this story’s a work of fiction!<$motion(0,40)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)>Eu vou fazer-lhe um melhor - eu vou mostrar-lhe!<$facial(2,2)><$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(0,0,2)>
<$emotion(2,230)><$voicel(2,3)>Ei, acho que você poderia me ajudar com um pouco de enredo’,
<$cdef(27)>?
Vou começar descrevendo o monstro, e eu quero você
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>transformar-se para demonstrar o que parece!
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,2)><$textsize(0)>Oh, e não se preocupe - esta história é uma obra de ficção!<$motion(0,40)>

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Yippee! I can’t wait to see this!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Yippee! Mal posso esperar para ver isso!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,2)><$motion(2,806)>All right, here it goes.
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,4)>So this monster had <$voicel(2,6)>a shell and a tail...<$motion(0,522)><$motion(0,523)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,2)><$motion(2,806)>Muito bem, aqui vai.
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,4)>Então, este monstro tinha... <$voicel(2,6)>Uma concha e uma cauda...<$motion(0,522)><$motion(0,523)>

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Uh-huh! And?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>E depois?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,4)>And its right hand was, uh... <$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,6)>Oh yeah!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,7)>Its right hand was a big ol’ scythe!<$motion(0,520)><$motion(0,521)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,4)>E a mão direita era... <$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,6)>Oh, sim!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,7)>Sua mão direita era uma grande foice!<$motion(0,520)><$motion(0,521)>

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,6)>Oooh, and what else?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,6)>Oooh, e que mais?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,4)>Its left hand was...<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,10)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,2)>uhhh...<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)> Oh yeah, I remember!
<$motion(2,644)><$comeff(2,23)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,9)>It was a huge, fierce-lookin’ fist!<$motion(0,518)><$motion(0,519)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,4)>A sua mão esquerda era...<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,10)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,2)>Uhhh...<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)> Sim, eu lembro-me!
<$motion(2,644)><$comeff(2,23)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,9)>Era um punho enorme, de olhar feroz!<$motion(0,518)><$motion(0,519)>

dialogues.en:
<$facial(1,14)><$voicel(1,2)>Pfff... <$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,9)>Ahahaha!
<$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)>That’s just regular ol’ <$cdef(27)>! Not even
CLOSE
to
a
scary monster!

<$facial(1,14)><$voicel(1,2)>Pfff... <$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,9)>Ahahaha!
<$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)>Isso é apenas regular ol’ <$cdef(27)>Nem sequer.

dialogues.en: <$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,10)><$comeff(2,11)><$voicel(2,9)>Ack! Busted!
dialogues.pt_br: <$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,10)><$comeff(2,11)><$voicel(2,9)>Apanhado!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,18)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)><$voicel(2,2)><$kfacial(2)>*sigh*...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,18)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)><$voicel(2,2)><$kfacial(2)>*suspiro *...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,5)>What’s wrong, sweetie? Why are you sighing?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,5)>O que há de errado, querida? Por que você está suspirando?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>Um, well... A little while ago, we were all racing each
other. <$emotion(2,291)><$voicel(2,4)>But I kept coming in last!
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,10)><$voicel(2,2)>No matter how much I practice, I just can’t get faster.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>Há pouco, estávamos todos a correr.
outro. <$emotion(2,291)><$voicel(2,4)>Mas eu continuei a vir em último!
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,10)><$voicel(2,2)>Não importa o quanto eu pratiquei, eu simplesmente não consigo ficar mais rápido.

dialogues.en:
<$facial(2,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Not giving up and continuing to practice even when you’re
losing is really quite admirable, dear! Have a little more
confidence in yourself!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(2,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Não desistir e continuar a praticar mesmo quando você está
perder é realmente muito admirável, querida! Ter um pouco mais
confiança em si mesmo!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,178)><$voicel(2,1)>You... You really think so? But I don’t think I can win.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,178)><$voicel(2,1)>Você... você realmente acha isso? Mas eu não acho que eu posso ganhar.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Well if that’s how you’re going to be about it, I guess I’ll
have to give you that self-confidence myself!
<$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Look here, hon—concentrate on the patterns on my body.
<$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,3)>That’s right. Now...you’re becoming a faaaster runner.
Faaaster and faaaster...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Bem, se é assim que você vai ser sobre isso, eu acho que eu vou
Tenho que te dar essa autoconfiança eu mesmo!
<$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Olha, querida, concentra-te nos padrões do meu corpo.
<$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,3)>Isso mesmo. Agora ... você está se tornando um corredor faaaster.
Faaaster e Faaaster...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)>Faster...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)>Mais rápido...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>And you’ll neeever lose a race again...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>E você vai precisar perder uma corrida novamente...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,2)>... ... ...
<$emotion(2,99)><$voicel(2,8)>I’m feeling a little more confident now, I think!
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>OK. In the next race, I’m gonna try my best!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,2)>... ... ...
<$emotion(2,99)><$voicel(2,8)>Estou me sentindo um pouco mais confiante agora, eu acho!
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>OK. Na próxima corrida, eu vou tentar o meu melhor!

dialogues.en: <$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Hee hee, that’s the spirit, sweetie!
dialogues.pt_br: <$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Hee hee, esse é o espírito, querida!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,10)>Hahaha! You’re pretty funny, <$cdef(27)><$cname(577)>!
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>I guess I kinda misjudged you, yo! <$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,4)>It’s just that I heard
rumors you were a real meanie, so...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,10)>Hahaha! Você é muito engraçado, <$cdef(27)><$cname(577)>!
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>Acho que te julguei mal, meu! <$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,4)>É só que eu ouvi
Há rumores de que eras mesmo mau, por isso...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,27)><$voicel(1,7)>Wha—?! There’s a rumor like that?! I’m...I’m not mean...
<$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,2)>I-I just get a little hungry sometimes...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,27)><$voicel(1,7)>O que -?! Há um rumor como esse?! Eu sou ... Eu não sou mau ...
<$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,2)>Às vezes fico com um pouco de fome...

dialogues.en: <$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,2)>A little hungry, huh? Hm... <wait(1.2)><$emotion(2,40)><$voicel(2,8)>Ohhh! I think I get it now!
dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,2)>Um pouco esfomeado, não é? <wait(1.2)><$emotion(2,40)><$voicel(2,8)>Acho que já percebi!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,59)><$voicel(1,5)>Wh-what do you mean?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,59)><$voicel(1,5)>O que quer dizer?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,7)>I bet you accidentally ate everybody’s berries! <$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>I get it,
yo! Stuff like that just happens sometimes. It’s no biggie!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,7)>Aposto que você acidentalmente comeu as bagas de todos! <$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>Já percebi.
Coisas assim só acontecem às vezes. Não é nada demais!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)>Huh?
<$voicel(1,2)>... ... ...
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, y-yeah! I just couldn’t resist...you know?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)>Huh?
<$voicel(1,2)>... ... ...
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, sim! Eu só não pude resistir ... você sabe?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,793)><$voicel(2,10)>Hahaha! Just watch out in the future and you’ll be fine!
<$emotion(2,39)><$voicel(2,7)>Actually, y’know what? Just let me know whenever you get
hungry! I’d be happy to share some food with you!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,793)><$voicel(2,10)>Hahaha! Basta ter cuidado no futuro e você vai ficar bem!
<$emotion(2,39)><$voicel(2,7)>Na verdade, você sabe o quê? Apenas me avise sempre que você chegar
fome! Eu ficaria feliz em compartilhar alguma comida com você!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>O-oh, really? <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,14)>Well then...
<$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,8)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Your spines look kinda tasty,<$cdef(27)> <$cname(603)>... Could I...maybe
try one?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>A sério? <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,14)>Bem, então...
<$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,8)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>As tuas espinhas parecem um pouco saborosas.<$cdef(27)> <$cname(603)>...podia eu...talvez
Tentar um?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,2)>... ... ...
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,5)>Hahaha! You’re jokin’, huh? My spines aren’t food!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,2)>... ... ...
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,5)>Hahaha! Você está brincando, hein? Minhas espinhas não são comida!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh... D-duh, obviously! I was just joking, so don’t worry
about it...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh... D-duh, obviamente! Eu estava apenas brincando, então não se preocupe
Sobre isso...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,10)>Haha! Not gonna lie, you almost had me for a second
there! Yep, you sure are a funny one, <$cdef(27)><$cname(577)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,10)>Não vou mentir, quase me apanhaste.
Sim, és mesmo engraçado. <$cdef(27)><$cname(577)>!
